title: Understanding Residuals
text: Residuals are the differences between the observed values and the predicted values from a model. In a linear regression model, the sum of the residuals is always zero if the model includes an intercept. However, in this case, the model is set with $$`fit_{intercept}=False`$$. What does this imply about the sum of residuals?

title: Effect of No Intercept
text: Consider the effect of setting $$`fit_{intercept}=False`$$ in the linear regression model. How does this affect the sum of the residuals?
